Week 3: Challenge of Power Amplifier (PA)
Week 4: Holiday
Week 5: Holiday
Week 6: Power Amplifier Circuits for UEs
Week 7: Transmitter (Tx)
Week 8: GaN PAs for 5G BS Transmitter Systems
Week 9: Simulation Software
Week 10: Experiment: Load-Pull test theory and data processing
Week 11: Experiment: Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) model design and training
Week 12: Experiment: Data completing, performance analysis, and optimization
Week 13: Project I: PA design and implementation
Week 14: Project I: PA circuit measurement
Week 15-17: Project II: Oscillator theory, design, simulation, and implementation
Week 18: Project II: Oscillator circuit measurement
